# Active minion count (adjustable, scales DPS)

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** minion, dps

## Derived / confirmed formula

Minion DPS = per-minion x active count. active_minions defaults to the summon-cap total and is user-adjustable in Config (capped at max); fewer active minions -> proportionally lower DPS. Also the numeric for 'when you have N Minions' gear.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped, unverified.

## Implementation (engine model)

compute.py injects active_minions default = summon-cap total before the loop; the minion pass uses min(active_minions, max) as the count fold (cast_multiplier). Verified: max 2 -> 2158 DPS, active 1 -> 1079 (exactly half).
